mapper.update: UPDATE provider_channel SET status = #{status}, supports_idempotent_submit = #{idempotentSubmit}, supports_query_by_attempt = #{queryByAttempt}, supports_cancel = #{cancel} WHERE code = #{code} AND kind = 'HTTP'
UPDATE provider_channel SET queued = queued + 1 WHERE code = #{code} AND queued < queue_capacity
UPDATE provider_channel SET queued = queued - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND queued > 0

UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight + 1, queued = queued - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND in_flight < max_in_flight AND queued > 0
AND (effective_in_flight IS NULL OR in_flight < effective_in_flight)
UPDATE provider_channel SET effective_in_flight = LEAST(COALESCE(effective_in_flight, #{initial}), max_in_flight), adaptive_window_at = NOW(3) WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_channel WHERE id = #{channelId} AND dispatch_paused_until > NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_channel SET effective_in_flight = effective_in_flight + 1, adaptive_window_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{channelId} AND effective_in_flight < max_in_flight AND adaptive_window_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND)
UPDATE provider_channel SET adaptive_window_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{channelId}

UPDATE provider_channel SET effective_in_flight = GREATEST(1, FLOOR(effective_in_flight / 2)), dispatch_paused_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{pauseSeconds} SECOND), adaptive_window_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{pauseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{channelId} AND effective_in_flight IS NOT NULL AND (dispatch_paused_until IS NULL OR dispatch_paused_until <= NOW(3))
UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND in_flight > 0
UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight - 1, queued = queued + 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND in_flight > 0
